signal_summary: Aave credit usage and V4 adoption are financially substantive and multi-day tracked-whale accumulation persists, but the apparent wallet breadth is materially weakened by concentration: Deep Blue Alpha reports one wallet responsible for 67% of AAVE tracked whale volume over 30 days. Direct token-level value capture is also presently weak because the DAO buyback program remains paused; V4 itself reports zero holder revenue. These blockers prevent a prospective paper starter despite strong protocol leadership.

regime_evidence.interpretation: Growth includes actual borrowing and fee generation, not merely supplied/AUM balances. V4 TVL excludes borrowed coins under DefiLlama methodology, while active-loan data separately confirms utilization.

wallet_evidence.caveat: Daily high-conviction counts are not proof of independent beneficial owners or historically selective smart money. The token-level concentration alert and mixed CEX/DEX methodology materially reduce confidence.

value_capture.reason: rsETH bridge incident / treasury balance-sheet flexibility
value_capture.note: Aave-branded revenue flows to the DAO treasury under the Aave Will Win framework, but treasury ownership/governance is not equivalent to automatic holder distribution. Acquired AAVE under the historical program was held in the ecosystem reserve rather than burned.

structural_gate.upgrade_control: AAVE token proxy administration is DAO/governance controlled and time-delayed rather than a unilateral EOA control; governance concentration remains a caveat.

forward_tests: Do not paper-buy AAVE on broad whale-count statistics alone. Require a selective-wallet cohort with independently verified funding/ownership and historical performance, or another genuinely independent confirmation leg.
Verify an on-chain restart of the AAVE buyback program or another direct token-holder value-capture mechanism before treating protocol revenue as token cash flow.
Require V4 active loans and fees to continue rising after launch/market-specific incentives are discounted, not merely supplied deposits/AUM.
Reassess governance/upgrade concentration if control structure materially changes or a privileged action bypasses normal timelocks.
